edits.modify_from: scan the demonstration frames in ascending t for the cube whose colour the goal instruction names. Each time the fingers open from a partly closed value (~46%) to ~100% in a frame after frames where that cube was 'held in the gripper', that is one release; its target is the one closest to where the cube rests in the frames right after the release, read from a frame listing all four targets (the demo's last frames do). Skip button presses (fingers 0% open, no cube held), skip the demonstration's final release, which leaves the cube near the image centre around [82, 127] with no target under it, and do not count a frame where the cube merely loses its 'held' label while the gripper stays raised. Number the remaining releases earliest first, take the entry the goal's ordinal names ('first' = 1, 'second' = 2, 'third' = 3, 'fourth' = 4), and write that target's [y, x]. At every later step copy the carried-in value unchanged. unknown only if no demonstration frames are shown and nothing is carried in. e.g. [107, 86]
edits.modify_to: follow this procedure and no other: (1) walk the demonstration frames in ascending t. (2) A placement is a frame where the gripper is low (height below ~0.07) and the fingers go from a partly closed value (~45% to ~95%; the low frame itself may read 67%, 80% or 93%) to ~100% open, right after frames in which the goal-named cube was carried (its line read 'held in the gripper' with the gripper raised). (3) Its target is the listed target closest to where the cube rests in the following frames, with coordinates taken from the last demonstration frame, where all four targets are listed. (4) Drop the demonstration's final placement (cube left near [82, 127], no target within ~15 pixels), drop button presses (fingers 0%, no cube carried), and do not count a carried cube that briefly loses its 'held' label while the gripper stays raised. (5) Number what is left 1, 2, 3, 4 earliest first and write the [y, x] of the target of the placement the goal's ordinal names ('first' = 1, 'second' = 2, 'third' = 3, 'fourth' = 4). Count forward from the earliest placement only, never backward from the most recent one; a button press between placements does not restart the count. Example: placements near [99, 90], [100, 163], [141, 133], [79, 90] then the centre set-down; 'second' gives the last-frame coordinates of the second, e.g. [98, 166]; 'first' gives [99, 90]. At every later step copy the carried-in value unchanged. unknown only if no demonstration frames are shown and nothing is carried in. e.g. [139, 124]
